about.title: 👤 Meet the Creator
about.content1: I’m Eng. Fahad, the guy who stayed up for a few days putting this project together to make travel expense tracking easier for everyone.
about.content2: The idea came during one of my trips — we kept asking: “Who paid? How much did we spend? Who still owes?”
about.content3: So I thought, why not build a simple tool that solves this once and for all?
about.content4: I built this site so you can:
about.list2: ✔️ See who paid what and what’s left
about.list4: ✔️ Share your trip with anyone using a unique code
about.content5: I’m not claiming to be a top expert, but I enjoy building things that help in real life.
about.content6: If you liked the site or have suggestions for improvements, feel free to reach out through my social accounts (you’ll find them down there👇).
about.thanks: Thanks for dropping by — wishing you smooth trips and smarter spending

home.hero.headline: Travel money, without the group-chat math.
home.hero.descriptionDesktop: Plan the budget. Collect the trip fund. Track expenses. Settle everything clearly.
home.hero.descriptionMobile: The dependable ledger for shared adventures. Track expenses, settle balances, and focus on the trip.
features.title: The Editorial Ledger
features.description: A rigorous, structured approach to managing group finances. Built on a paper metaphor with hard-edged precision.
features.section1.title: The Split Engine
features.section1.description: Complex group math reduced to simple, auditable transactions. Every expense acts as a deliberate record in a shared physical ledger.
features.section1.items.exactSplits.desc: Distribute costs evenly or itemize line-by-line for ultimate precision.
features.section1.items.multiCurrency.de: Native support for cross-border trips with historical rate locking.
features.section1.demo.title: Dinner at Luigi's
features.section1.demo.rows.paid.name: Alex (Paid)
features.section1.demo.rows.owes1.name: Sam (Owes)
features.section1.demo.rows.owes2.name: Jordan (Owes)
features.section2.title: Settlement Architecture
features.section2.cards.debt.title: Debt Minimization
features.section2.cards.debt.description: Our proprietary algorithm calculates the absolute fewest number of transactions required to settle all debts within the group, avoiding circular payments.
features.section2.cards.bank.title: Direct Bank Links
features.section2.cards.bank.description: Export settlement instructions directly to standard banking formats or integrate with modern payment gateways for one-click resolution.
